summary: The change conforms to spec, plan, data-model and tasks on every functional requirement, acceptance scenario, edge case and contract; the only divergence is a recorded red-proof prediction error in T007's own task text, already self-reported in its commit and remediated by T011.

findings.summary: T007's red state did not fail the Seam 4 gate as its task text demands: the committed tree at that point had no references/harness/zcode.md in the four existing skill trees, but those were untracked additions, so git diff --exit-code -- dist/ exited 0 and the divergence was only visible in git status.
findings.evidence: tasks.md T007: 'MUST fail now: zcode.md is in no skill tree, and because dist/ is tracked the difference check reports the divergence and exits non-zero rather than passing vacuously.' Commit 4ed16a9 body records the deviation: 'Deviation from the plan's prediction, recorded: git diff --exit-code -- dist/ exits 0 here because plain git diff reports only modifications to tracked files, and these four files are additions... The divergence is reported by git status rather than the gate's exit code.' The red was nonetheless observed (git status '?? dist/<h>/skill/references/harness/zcode.md' x4) and T011 (034c1de) re-commits the full tracked render, after which T017 re-confirms the gate fails on a tracked-file edit.
findings.fix: Optional: correct T007's expectation text (the red is observed via git status until the tree is fully tracked) or accept the recorded deviation; the final invariant of SC-003/SC-006 holds and no code change is required.
